description: Bounded calibration fixture for semantic_contradiction primitive. Exercises contradiction detection across artifacts under the four fixed evidence states.

claims.description: Two artifacts make directly contradictory assertions about property P1. Enough evidence is available to detect the contradiction.
claims.assertion: Artifact A states P1=required and Artifact B states P1=optional for the same scope.

claims.description: No contradiction detected. Both artifacts make compatible assertions about property P2.
claims.assertion: Artifact A and Artifact B both declare P2=required.

claims.description: Contradiction check where one side of the potential contradiction is not available.
claims.assertion: Artifact A and Artifact Missing are contradictory regarding P3.

claims.description: Evidence sources disagree about whether a contradiction exists. One interpretation sees contradiction; another does not.
claims.assertion: Artifact A and Artifact B are contradictory regarding P4.
expected_evidence: source-1 asserts P4 values are contradictory
source-2 asserts P4 values are compatible in context

claims.description: Contradiction claim about a domain not supported by available evidence. The contradiction claim itself cannot be meaningfully evaluated.
claims.assertion: Artifact A and Artifact B contradict on undefined property P5.
